instructions_summary: Players dribble to a center cone, perform a jump stop and pivot, then make an overhead pass to the next player.
difficulty_modification: Call receiver's name or add movement after passing
solo_adaptation_note: Practice passing against a wall

instructions_summary: Players practice stationary crossover dribbles at low, middle, and high levels to develop ball control.
difficulty_modification: Add partner mirroring or extra crossovers
solo_adaptation_note: Practice stationary crossovers independently

instructions_summary: Players dribble through cones in a zigzag pattern, changing hands as they change direction.
difficulty_modification: Replace cones with defenders
solo_adaptation_note: Dribble through cones independently

instructions_summary: Players practice one-handed shooting close to the basket, focusing on shooting form and follow-through.
difficulty_modification: Not specified
solo_adaptation_note: Practice one-handed form shooting independently

instructions_summary: Players follow movement instructions to reach different court lines, practicing movements such as skipping and high knees.
difficulty_modification: Add basketballs or dribbling to the movements
solo_adaptation_note: Perform court-line movements independently

instructions_summary: Four players take turns chasing and escaping while dribbling between court baselines.
difficulty_modification: Require players to dribble using only their non-dominant hand
solo_adaptation_note: Chase game requires other players

instructions_summary: An offensive player reads the coach's position to choose between driving for a layup and taking a jump shot while facing a defender.
difficulty_modification: Not specified
solo_adaptation_note: Original decision drill requires a defender and coach

instructions_summary: Groups of three rotate through shooting, rebounding, passing, and relocating to new shooting positions.
difficulty_modification: Change the shooting location or shot type between rounds
solo_adaptation_note: Shoot, rebound, and relocate independently

instructions_summary: Players move across the court and perform balanced jump stops in response to the coach's signals.
difficulty_modification: Add dribbling before each jump stop
solo_adaptation_note: Practice jump stops using predetermined court markers

instructions_summary: Players practice defensive stance, lateral slides, and shot contests while following a leader's cues.
difficulty_modification: Assign players to lead small groups and give defensive movement cues
solo_adaptation_note: Practice defensive slides using fixed court markers

instructions_summary: Three offensive players compete against two defenders, using passing and quick decisions to create scoring opportunities.
difficulty_modification: Limit offensive players to one second of ball possession
solo_adaptation_note: 3-on-2 game requires multiple players

instructions_summary: Teams compete in dribbling relays, performing jump stops and returning to their teammates before switching hands.
difficulty_modification: Replace backpedaling with defensive slides or sprinting
solo_adaptation_note: Perform timed dribbling runs independently

instructions_summary: Numbered teams compete in short three-on-three possessions, practicing offensive teamwork and active defense.
difficulty_modification: Not specified
solo_adaptation_note: 3-on-3 game requires multiple players

instructions_summary: Players dribble around a half court. On the coach's signal, they stop in a triple threat stance, then resume dribbling.
difficulty_modification: Use the off-hand or add crossover dribbles.
solo_adaptation_note: Practice dribbling and triple threat transitions using predetermined cues.

instructions_summary: Players dribble forward to court markers, take two retreat dribbles, square up, and repeat using both hands.
difficulty_modification: Add a crossover or between-the-legs move after the retreat.
solo_adaptation_note: Perform the retreat dribble sequence independently.

instructions_summary: Players work in pairs inside a marked square. One player protects the ball while the defender attempts to steal it. Players then switch roles.
difficulty_modification: Not specified
solo_adaptation_note: The original activity requires a defender.

instructions_summary: Two offensive players rebound and make an outlet pass, then advance upcourt against defenders in transition.
difficulty_modification: Not specified
solo_adaptation_note: Original transition game requires multiple players.

instructions_summary: Partners roll the ball to each other and practice catching, drop-step footwork, and simulated lay-ups.
difficulty_modification: Practice the drop step with both feet.
solo_adaptation_note: Practice the drop-step footwork independently without the partner pass.

instructions_summary: Players rotate through three lines and practice different lay-up finishes, including euro steps.
difficulty_modification: Add euro-step finishes.
solo_adaptation_note: Practice lay-ups from different positions around the basket independently.

instructions_summary: Two offensive players pass and shoot against one defender, using at most three passes.
difficulty_modification: Allow two dribbles or add a third offensive player.
solo_adaptation_note: Original game requires offensive players and a defender.

instructions_summary: Players pass to a teammate, cut toward the basket, and react to whether the cutter is defended.
difficulty_modification: Not specified
solo_adaptation_note: Original drill requires passing partners and a defender.

instructions_summary: A ball-handler chooses a baseline or middle drive; a teammate reacts by relocating for a shot or cutting for a lay-up.
difficulty_modification: Not specified
solo_adaptation_note: Original read-and-react drill requires a teammate.

instructions_summary: The coach calls two team numbers and players compete in a live 3-on-3 possession.
difficulty_modification: Not specified
solo_adaptation_note: Original game requires two teams of three.
